text: A fan asked when Ashquill Rovers next play; the desk gave the 2026-10-10 home match at Harbour Park.
The Lowfennel Albion captain asked how many yellow cards Nell Tarrant had; the desk reported five and pointed to the one-match ban.
A parent asked about the length of a match; the desk answered two halves of 40 minutes.
A player asked for the premier division table; the desk reported Ashquill Rovers on 22 points.
A captain asked whether Quarry Lane would be playable after heavy rain; the desk explained the 10:00 weather call.
A fan asked how many goals Tomas Verrin had scored; the desk reported nine in eight appearances.
The Millcress Athletic captain asked about the squad size limit; the desk answered 16 players.
A captain asked the league office to register a late signing; the desk said it cannot register players and gave the office hours.
A fan asked what the pitch is like at Harbour Park; the desk answered 3G artificial turf.
A player asked how a red card ban works; the desk answered at least two matches and referred appeals to the league office.
